about: Party stands (scripted camp fight): during a ScriptedPullRegistry stage's camp fight both assist triggers stood down and the multiplier zeroed stock proactive picks, so a follower the pack never reached stood at camp. Measured on tp-20260808-191156-1 (MgT heroic): scripted rows median 3.0s to first contact, 6% over 15s; in tr-20260808-191202-9 the east rotunda row ran 62s with the rogue entering combat 29s and the hunter 59s after release. This stages that east row (ranged tag, forward camp 137.1,-179.2) with its north-east neighbour formation, which comes with it; the south/centre rows and the hall patrol are hidden, so the east row is the first live stage. Fixed on master by f9a7a879 (ScriptedCampFightIsAtCamp opens the non-combat seed for mobs within the 12yd follower leash of camp).
